summary:
ACT 18 HAS A HOME AND IT IS EP 73. The stored map adapted renewal Act 18 nowhere; the pages put its opening beat in ep 73, so the row's END moves 17 -> 18 and Sean's A41 rearranged record moves with it (15-17 -> 15-18) — one ask, two records, both delivered as repairs. Eps 74, 75, 76 and 77 adapt NO act at all and take no anchor: 74 and 75 are anchor_hostile under A44, 76 and 77 under A44 and (proposed) A1. Ep 75's STORED anchor 19 [19] is refuted and deleted. Types: 73 CONFIRMED canon, 74 CONFIRMED canon, and 75 / 76 / 77 proposed FILLER (75 medium, 76 and 77 high) — the same shape Sean already ruled on ep 72 in batch 22 wave 3.

1. THE CHAPTER SPACE (N35), STATED FIRST BECAUSE EVERY NUMBER DEPENDS ON IT. Sailor Moon has two act spaces and four independent lineages agree on both ceilings. (a) ORIGINAL 18-volume tankobon = 52 acts: ja-WP's オリジナル版 table (「話数は旧単行本より」) runs Act1 … Act52 スターズ10, and gives vol 4 = Act13 終結そして始まり / Act14 ブラック・ムーン・コーアン—SAILORMARS / Act15 ブラック・ムーン・ベルチェ—SAILORMERCURY / Act16 ブラック・ムーン・ペッツ—SAILORJUPITER, vol 5 = Act17 ブラックムーン・カラベラス—SAILORVENUS / Act18 タイムワープ—SAILORPLUTO / Act19 クリスタルトーキョー—KING ENDYMION. (b) RENEWAL = 60 acts: ja-WP's 新装版 table runs Act1 … Act60 スターズ11 across 12 volumes, with Act17 秘密—SAILORJUPITER, Act18 侵略—SAILORVENUS, Act19 タイム・ワープ—SAILORPLUTO in 新装版 vol 4; en-WP's 'List of Sailor Moon chapters' prints those same renewal numbers and titles against the OLD 18 volumes (vol 4 = Acts 14-17, vol 5 = Acts 18-20, … vol 18 = Acts 56-60), which is exactly the stored volume table; wikimoon.org prints BOTH numbers in one infobox on every act page — Act 18 侵略 SAILORVENUS: 'Chapter Number: 18 / Original Number: 17', Act 17: '17 / 16', Act 19: '19 / 18', and the terminal act, Act 60 スターズ11: 'Chapter Number: 60 / Original Number: 52 / Next Chapter: N/A'; and MangaUpdates' coverage string for this very work ends 'Vol 18, Chap 60 (Cosmos Movie 2)'. SO: latest_known 60 is CORRECT and the ceiling is 60 on four lineages. THE STORED total_chapters 61 IS SUPPORTED BY NO PAGE I READ. It is AniList's count (staged in the context; the AniList API has been down since 2026-09-06 and I did not guess at it). The renewal edition's numbered mainline is Act 1-60 and nothing else; the short stories are printed in a SEPARATE two-volume ショートストーリーズ[短編集] and are numbered per-series (ちびうさ絵日記 第1-3話, 受験戦争編 第1-3話) or not at all (かぐや姫の恋人, カサブランカ・メモリー, ぱられる せぇらぁむ〜ん, ヒミツのハンマープライス堂) — there is no 61st mainline act to point at, and the batch-22 note's guess ('60 + one short-story unit') remains a guess. I propose the N35 entry as 60 and flag total_chapters 61 as a one-off to reconcile when AniList is reachable, NOT as a repair I can source today.

2. ROW IDENTITY (R20, joined on title + date, never index). Our cumulative 73-77 = Sailor Moon R 27-31 on every source: ja-WP's 各話リスト prints the pair form 73（27）「UFO出現! さらわれたS戦士達」11月6日 / 74（28）11月13日 / 75（29）11月20日 / 76（30）12月4日 / 77（31）12月11日; en-WP's Sailor Moon R article carries EpisodeNumber 73 / EpisodeNumber3 27 with 1993-11-06 and the same pairs down to 77/31 at 1993-12-11; sailormoon.fandom's infoboxes say 'ep number 73, season number 2, November 6, 1993' etc.; wikimoon.org says 'Episode Number: 73 … Air Date: November 6, 1993'; ja-WP's 地場衛 page even writes the join out ('テレビアニメ『美少女戦士セーラームーンR』31話（通算77話）'); Toei's own per-episode pages are numbered in R space (episode/27/ = 「UFO出現! さらわれたS戦士達」). Every stored title and air date is confirmed; NO date or title repair. Day-of-week sweep: 1993-11-06 / 11-13 / 11-20 / 12-04 / 12-11 are all Saturdays, the show's slot; the missing 1993-11-27 is a real preemption (ja-WP's table skips it too), not a lost row.

3. WHAT RENEWAL ACT 18 侵略—SAILORVENUS CONTAINS, and where each piece went. sailormoon.fandom's Act 18 page, read scene by scene: Petz's Dark Crystal earring is analysed; Chibiusa recoils from it; the Black Moon sends the last sister Calaveras, a medium, onto television to turn the public against the guardians; Mamoru consults the Shitennou stones; 'Chibiusa sneaks into Usagi's room and steals her Crystal Star broach to obtain the Silver Crystal of the past'; Venus fights Calaveras at the TV station; 'As an angry Usagi goes to retrieve her broach from Chibiusa, they are attacked by Rubeus' and Tuxedo Mask drives him off with Tuxedo La Smoking Bomber; Sailor Moon takes the brooch back and destroys Calaveras; Chibiusa finally admits she is from the future and begs for help. Two further lineages carry the same act: ja-WP's ブラック・ムーン一族 tells it twice (Rubeus's 原作 paragraph — Calaveras attacks Venus while Rubeus goes for Usagi and Chibiusa, is met by 「タキシード・ラ・スモーキング・ボンバー」 and retreats, so 「カラベラスは倒されヴィーナスの連れ去りは失敗した」 — and Calaveras's own 原作 paragraph, 「予言者「ミス・カラベラス」としてテレビ出演し、[[チャネリング]]でブラック・ムーンの予言と思想を宣伝する。」), and en-WP's Sailor Moon Crystal ep 18 'Invasion -Sailor Venus-' (Crystal adapts act for act) — 'While Minako faces Calaveras, Rubeus confronts Usagi and Chibiusa, but they are saved by Mamoru … Chibiusa explains that she comes from 30th century Earth to seek Usagi's help in saving her time.' For the brooch beat specifically the second lineage is wikimoon.org, whose Act 18 page illustrates the act with the caption 'Usagi discovers her brooch is missing'.

4. EP 73 ANIMATES ACT 18'S OPENING — five independent readings, one of them the licensor. Toei Animation's own per-episode synopsis for R27 (a licensor primary the batch-22 verdict recorded as non-existent; it exists, see the flags): 「失敗続きで進退きわまったルベウスは、みずからセーラー戦士抹殺のために行動を開始する。一方、ちびうさは、うさぎが部屋に置き忘れた銀水晶のブローチを見つけ、そのまま持ち去ってしまった。しかし、未来へ帰れなくて泣き出してしまったちびうさのもとに、ルベウスが現われる。そこへセーラー戦士がやってきて一度は難を逃れるが、セーラー戦士を信じられなくなっていたちびうさは、再びひとりで逃げ出してしまった！」 Bandai Channel's page for the same episode carries the same beats. ja-WP's ちびうさ page dates the theft to this row by footnote: 「銀水晶入りの変身ブローチを盗んでしまい<ref>初代テレビアニメ『美少女戦士セーラームーンR』27話</ref>、そのまま未来に帰ろうとしたが時空のカギは反応しなかった。」 — and its 原作 paragraph describes the manga's identical pair of beats, 「「過去の幻の銀水晶」が入ったうさぎの変身ブローチを盗んで未来に帰ろうとしたが失敗。」 en-WP's ep-73 summary leads with it: 'Chibiusa, saddened and confused that Usagi is the Legendary Sailor Moon, steals the Silver Crystal and tries to go back to the future … Due to Chibiusa's meddling, Rubeus succeeds in capturing the other Guardians.' And sailormoon.fandom's ep-74 plot closes the loop from the other side: 'Back at Mamoru's apartment, Chibiusa had returned Usagi her brooch but is guilt-ridden for her actions.' Three of Toei's four sentences are this thread and it is the causal engine of the episode (theft -> failed return -> Rubeus finds her -> the guardians come looking -> they are taken), so under the SLIVER CLAUSE this segment is SIGNIFICANT, not a sliver: it is a scene, it progresses the story, it is first-time, and no other episode of the 200 animates it.

5. THE OTHER SEGMENT OF EP 73 IS THE RULED ONE, AND IT STANDS. Sean's A41 record has ep 73 condensing the Acts 15-17 abduction motif after ep 71 already reached Act 16. sailormoon.fandom's 'Changes From the Manga' for ep 73 states the source side exactly: 'Sailor Mars, Sailor Mercury and Sailor Jupiter aren't abducted at the same time: Mars is captured in Act 15, Mercury, in Act 16 and Jupiter is taken away in Act 17', plus 'In the manga, Sailor Venus was never abducted by Rubeus, and the Ayakashi Sisters helped in the capture of the other Senshi.' Nothing refutes the ruled reading; the repair only EXTENDS it. weight: SIGNIFICANT — first-time delivery of the source outcome that the inner guardians are captured by the Black Moon, restaged (one mass abduction by Rubeus alone, Venus added, the sisters already human).

6. THE REST OF ACT 18 IS ADAPTED NOWHERE — that is the answer to the second half of the ask, and it is a negative with sources. Calaveras's Miss-Calaveras broadcast, the mass brainwashing, Venus's duel at the TV station, Mamoru and the Shitennou stones and Calaveras's DEATH are in none of eps 74-77, and cannot be: the anime turned Calaveras into a human two episodes earlier. ja-WP's カラベラス 初代テレビアニメ paragraph ends 「ペッツとともにセーラームーンに浄化されて人間となった。」 and the arc paragraph adds 「その後は20世紀で化粧品の販売をしながら4人で仲良く生活している。」; wikimoon.org's ep-72 summary says the same ('to turn Petz and Calaveras into humans'); sailormoon.fandom's ep-72 'Changes from the Manga' is the one line 'Petz and Calaveras, like their two younger sisters, were killed by Moon Princess Halation'. Act 18's closing confession is likewise not in 74-77: ja-WP's ちびうさ page runs the anime's next beats straight from R28 (the UFO) to R29 (the mind world) to the Juban primary school, Kiral and Akiral and 「時空の鍵の力でムーン達を未来に連れていく」, i.e. our eps 81-82, where the stored map already anchors ep 82 -> Act 19.

7. EP 74 — canon as stored, but no position. Its plot (Toei R28: 「セーラー戦士4人が、ルベウスのUFOに連れ去られてしまった。…UFOはいつの間にか地球を離れて、宇宙空間へと飛び出してしまっていた！」; sailormoon.fandom's full plot; ja-WP's ルベウス paragraph) is the anime's own resolution of the anime's own abduction: the ultimatum, the crosses, the gravity duel, Chibiusa prising out the Malefic Black Crystal, the teleport out, Esmeraude abandoning Rubeus to the explosion. The source's corresponding events sit in renewal Acts 21-22 and are staged completely differently — sailormoon.fandom's own 'Changes from the manga' for this row: 'Rubeus is killed by Wiseman and dies after Esmeraude' and 'Sailor Moon frees the Sailor Guardians (except Venus, who was not captured) when she was taken prisoner to Nemesis.' No act's pages are animated here, so A44 refuses the anchor; the stored abridged{15-18} block annotation on eps 70,74 already carries the condensation and is confirmed unchanged.

8. EP 75 — THE STORED ANCHOR 19 [19] IS REFUTED. wikimoon.org's full summary of the episode is available (contra the batch-22 note that WikiMoon has no Wayback article snapshots — it does) and it contains no page of Act 19: Chibiusa collapses under the Malefic Black Crystal, Luna P turns into a translucent orb in which Sailor Pluto's IMAGE appears, the guardians are sent into Chibiusa's mind, they fight a scythe-wielding Droid in a dream Crystal Tokyo that Rei explicitly says 'could just be what Crystal Tokyo looks like in Chibiusa's mind, and not in the real future', Chibiusa opens her heart, and Pluto tells her she is not ready to go home. Toei R29 says the same: 「助けを求めるちびうさの声に反応して、ルナPボールを通してセーラープルートが現われた！…うさぎたちは、ちびうさの心の中に入りちびうさを探す。」 ja-WP's 冥王せつな 初代テレビアニメ paragraph says it in one sentence: 「邪黒水晶に侵されたちびうさが倒れるとルナPボールのホログラム映像を通して現れ、うさぎ達をちびうさの夢の中の世界に転移させた。」 Act 19 in the source is the Space-Time Door journey with Pluto in person, and sailormoon.fandom's own 'Changes from the Manga' for ep 75 is the single line 'The Sailor Guardians first meet Sailor Pluto when they reach the Space-Time Door' — which the anime does at ep 82, where the stored map already anchors Act 19. This is the CHARACTER-TIMING shape the catalog has already ruled three times on this very series under A7/A2 (ep 103, ep 113, ep 133: 'a character-timing difference … not adapted chapters — no position to record'), and under the SLIVER CLAUSE an advanced debut plus a dream preview is a sliver: it earns neither a type nor an anchor. The anchor is deleted, the tie is kept as loose_parallel{18-19}.

9. EPS 76 AND 77 — no act, and (proposed) not canon either. Both are episodes of the anime-only Dark Henge campaign. ja-WP's ブラック・ムーン一族 glossary marks the whole device 「初代テレビアニメ版のみ登場。」 three times over — クリスタルポイント, ネガティブポイント and ダルクヘンジ — and lists ep 76's ケーキ店『Maxi-5』 and ep 77's プロミスリング用品店 among the seven Negative Points. Ep 76 (Toei R30 + wikimoon's full summary) is Esmeraude finding a Negative Point under a new cake shop, Usagi binge-eating out of jealousy, the Droid Marzipan, and Esmeraude introducing herself — not one source scene. Ep 77 (Toei R31 + wikimoon's full summary) is the promise-ring craze, the Droid Udering, Usagi's wedding nightmare and the reconciliation, and wikimoon's trivia line names the subplot outright: 'This episode marks the resolution of the unique-to-the-anime "break up" subplot that began in episode 61' — the catalog already records that overlay as divergence{15-19} with 61 and 77 as its endpoint rows, and ja-WP's 地場衛 page confirms the device is the anime's invention ('実はこの予知夢は、未来の自分であるキング・エンディミオンが二人の絆を確かめるために見せたものだった', cited to 『R』31話（通算77話）).

10. WHY THE STORED TYPES SAY OTHERWISE, AND WHY THAT IS NOT EVIDENCE. The stored types for 73-77 are animefillerlist's row for row (73 Manga Canon, 74 Manga Canon, 75 Manga Canon, 76 Mixed, 77 Manga Canon) — an arc-level community label with no chapter behind it, and the catalog does not read AFL/AFG as a type witness (they are one lineage). The same label put 'Manga Canon' on ep 72 until Sean retyped it filler on 2026-09-05, and the batch-22 verdict's own flag predicted this: 'the same test would probably move other rows in this block (76, 77 and 81 are the obvious candidates)'. 81 is outside this ask and is NOT researched here.

11. EVERY act number below is in the 60-ACT RENEWAL SPACE (新装版 2003-04 / 完全版 / 文庫版 / Kodansha USA), which is the STORED space. In the ORIGINAL 52-act tankobon space the same acts are ONE LOWER in this region: renewal 17 秘密—SAILORJUPITER = original 16 ブラック・ムーン・ペッツ, renewal 18 侵略—SAILORVENUS = original 17 ブラックムーン・カラベラス, renewal 19 タイム・ワープ—SAILORPLUTO = original 18 タイムワープ.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 15-17 (abduction motif condensed), 18 (opening: Chibiusa steals the Crystal Star brooch with the Silver Crystal inside, fails to return to the future, and is found by Rubeus)
anchors.note: EVERY act number below is in the 60-ACT RENEWAL SPACE (新装版 2003-04 / 完全版 / 文庫版 / Kodansha USA), which is the STORED space. In the ORIGINAL 52-act tankobon space the same acts are ONE LOWER in this region: renewal 17 秘密—SAILORJUPITER = original 16 ブラック・ムーン・ペッツ, renewal 18 侵略—SAILORVENUS = original 17 ブラックムーン・カラベラス, renewal 19 タイム・ワープ—SAILORPLUTO = original 18 タイムワープ. END 18 (A4: the furthest mainline act adapted in this row), START 15 unchanged (Sean's ruled A41 re-tread), volume 5 because renewal Act 18 opens en-WP's vol 5 (Acts 18-20) — the stored table agrees (v4 14-17, v5 18-20), so the stored v4 is a consequence of the wrong END and moves with it. SEGMENT WEIGHTS (T28 sliver clause). (i) Act 18's opening — weight: SIGNIFICANT — because it is a scene, not a fragment, it progresses the story (Usagi loses the brooch and cannot transform; Chibiusa's motive and her failed escape are shown), it is FIRST-TIME material shown in no other episode of the 200, and it is the episode's causal engine: Toei's own synopsis gives it three of four sentences 「一方、ちびうさは、うさぎが部屋に置き忘れた銀水晶のブローチを見つけ、そのまま持ち去ってしまった。しかし、未来へ帰れなくて泣き出してしまったちびうさのもとに、ルベウスが現われる。そこへセーラー戦士がやってきて一度は難を逃れる」, en-WP leads its summary with it, and ja-WP's ちびうさ page footnotes it to 『R』27話. The manga beat is the same pair: 「「過去の幻の銀水晶」が入ったうさぎの変身ブローチを盗んで未来に帰ろうとしたが失敗。」 (ja-WP, 原作) and 'Chibiusa sneaks into Usagi's room and steals her Crystal Star broach to obtain the Silver Crystal of the past' (sailormoon.fandom, Act 18) — wikimoon.org's Act 18 page illustrates the act with the caption 'Usagi discovers her brooch is missing'. (ii) Acts 15-17's abduction — weight: SIGNIFICANT (as ruled, A41) — because it is the first and only time the anime delivers the source's outcome that Mars, Mercury and Jupiter are taken by the Black Moon; restaged as one mass abduction by Rubeus with Venus added, the sisters having already been redeemed (sailormoon.fandom's 'Changes From the Manga': 'Mars is captured in Act 15, Mercury, in Act 16 and Jupiter is taken away in Act 17' and 'In the manga, Sailor Venus was never abducted by Rubeus'). WHAT IS NOT ADAPTED HERE AND NOWHERE ELSE: the rest of Act 18 — Calaveras's Miss-Calaveras broadcast and the mass brainwashing, Venus's duel with her at the TV station, Mamoru and the Shitennou stones, Calaveras's death, and Chibiusa's confession. The anime cannot animate Calaveras's death because it turned her human at ep 72 (ja-WP: 「ペッツとともにセーラームーンに浄化されて人間となった。」). A47 is TESTED AND DOES NOT APPLY: its exception holds an END back only when the NEXT anchored episode STARTS on the same chapter, and no episode starts on Act 18 — the next anchored row is ep 82 -> Act 19. The A47 existence clause (R3 before A47) is satisfied several times over: five independent lineages carry the Act-18 material in this row (Toei, Bandai Channel, ja-WP, en-WP, sailormoon.fandom). ANIME-ORIGINAL IN THIS ROW (noted, not weighed toward a retype under the T28 faithfulness clause): Rubeus's UFO, the black-crystal crosses, Esmeraude's debut and her warning to Rubeus (in the manga Esmeraude appears at the Black Moon arc's start and dies in Act 20).

continue_points.why: C1, NOT C2 — READ THIS BEFORE THE HEALER TOUCHES IT. Ep 73 leaves renewal Act 18 UNFINISHED: it animates the act's opening (the brooch theft, the failed return, Rubeus's arrival) and none of its remainder, so C1 puts the continue INSIDE the straddled chapter — 18. C2/C3 parity is tested and does NOT apply, because parity is for material the anime covers LATER, and Act 18's remainder is covered in no episode of the 200: Calaveras is human from ep 72 (ja-WP 「ペッツとともにセーラームーンに浄化されて人間となった。」), so her broadcast, her duel with Venus and her death can never be animated, and Chibiusa's confession is displaced into the anime-original future journey at eps 81-82. The next anchored row is ep 82 -> Act 19 [19]; a healer that raises this value to 19 on 'parity with the next START' would silently tell the reader to skip pages the anime never showed, which is the exact failure the honest-gap rule exists to prevent. kind is written 'parity' only because the schema admits parity | post_series; the rule is C1. WHAT THE READER SHOULD KNOW ON ARRIVAL (C3-style skip note): the first pages of Act 18 (Petz's earring, Chibiusa's fear of it, the theft) have already been seen in altered form, and Act 18's Rubeus confrontation is restaged in ep 73 with the guardians rather than Tuxedo Mask; everything from Calaveras's television debut onward is new. EVERY act number below is in the 60-ACT RENEWAL SPACE (新装版 2003-04 / 完全版 / 文庫版 / Kodansha USA), which is the STORED space. In the ORIGINAL 52-act tankobon space the same acts are ONE LOWER in this region: renewal 17 秘密—SAILORJUPITER = original 16 ブラック・ムーン・ペッツ, renewal 18 侵略—SAILORVENUS = original 17 ブラックムーン・カラベラス, renewal 19 タイム・ワープ—SAILORPLUTO = original 18 タイムワープ.

anchor_hostile.why: NO ANCHOR — A44: the row animates no act's pages, so there is no position to record. Its whole plot is the anime's own resolution of the anime's own mass abduction. Toei R28: 「セーラー戦士4人が、ルベウスのUFOに連れ去られてしまった。うさぎは仲間を取り戻すために、ひとりでルベウスのもとへ行く決意を固める。ちびうさも、そんなうさぎを追って家を飛び出してしまう。…UFOはいつの間にか地球を離れて、宇宙空間へと飛び出してしまっていた！」 sailormoon.fandom's plot adds the ultimatum, the guardians on black-crystal crosses, the gravity duel, Chibiusa prising out the Malefic Black Crystal, the sailor-teleport escape and Esmeraude abandoning Rubeus to the explosion; ja-WP's ルベウス 初代テレビアニメ paragraph tells the same episode in Japanese and ends 「エスメロードに助けを求めるが見限られてUFOの爆発で絶命した」. THE SOURCE'S CORRESPONDING EVENTS ARE ELSEWHERE AND STAGED DIFFERENTLY: sailormoon.fandom's own 'Changes from the manga' for this row is 'Rubeus is killed by Wiseman and dies after Esmeraude' and 'Sailor Moon frees the Sailor Guardians (except Venus, who was not captured) when she was taken prisoner to Nemesis. She used her power to free them, damaging the planet and teleporting them all to Crystal Tokyo' — renewal Acts 21-22, which the stored map already reaches at ep 83 (-> 20, '21 elements') and ep 85 (-> 23 [22]). What survives is OUTCOME ONLY (the guardians are freed; Rubeus dies), delivered through invented staging, which under the sliver clause carries no position. The stored abridged{15-18} annotation on eps 70,74 already records the condensation and is CONFIRMED unchanged. ACT 18 IS NOT HERE: no Calaveras broadcast, no Venus duel, no Shitennou stones, no confession — and Chibiusa has already given the brooch back off-screen ('Back at Mamoru's apartment, Chibiusa had returned Usagi her brooch'). EVERY act number below is in the 60-ACT RENEWAL SPACE (新装版 2003-04 / 完全版 / 文庫版 / Kodansha USA), which is the STORED space. In the ORIGINAL 52-act tankobon space the same acts are ONE LOWER in this region: renewal 17 秘密—SAILORJUPITER = original 16 ブラック・ムーン・ペッツ, renewal 18 侵略—SAILORVENUS = original 17 ブラックムーン・カラベラス, renewal 19 タイム・ワープ—SAILORPLUTO = original 18 タイムワープ.

NO ANCHOR, AND THE STORED ONE IS DELETED (see repairs). A44 first and independently of any retype: the episode animates no page of renewal Act 19. wikimoon.org's full summary (a lineage the batch-22 verdict recorded as unreachable — its article namespace IS in the Wayback Machine) runs: Chibiusa collapses under the Malefic Black Crystal; 'Luna P changes into a translucent orb in which appears the image of a woman who introduces herself as Sailor Pluto'; the guardians enter Chibiusa's MIND; they fight a scythe-wielding Droid in a ruined city that 'Rei says … could just be what Crystal Tokyo looks like in Chibiusa's mind, and not in the real future'; Chibiusa opens her heart; Pluto tells her she is not ready to go home. Toei R29 is the same episode: 「ちびうさは、熱と悪夢にうなされ「邪黒水晶」の名を口にして苦しんでいた。助けを求めるちびうさの声に反応して、ルナPボールを通してセーラープルートが現われた！…うさぎたちは、ちびうさの心の中に入りちびうさを探す。」 ja-WP's 冥王せつな compresses it to 「邪黒水晶に侵されたちびうさが倒れるとルナPボールのホログラム映像を通して現れ、うさぎ達をちびうさの夢の中の世界に転移させた。」 ACT 19 IS THE SPACE-TIME DOOR JOURNEY WITH PLUTO IN PERSON, and sailormoon.fandom's 'Changes from the Manga' for this row is exactly one line — 'The Sailor Guardians first meet Sailor Pluto when they reach the Space-Time Door' — which the anime does at ep 82 (stored ep 82 -> 19 [19] {19 (time warp, Space-Time Door, Pluto in person)}); the fandom's own trivia adds 'While Sailor Pluto appears for the first time in this episode, she would not debut physically until later in the season'. So the stored '19 (partial: Sailor Pluto's debut, ahead of the time warp)' records a CHARACTER-TIMING DIFFERENCE, not adapted pages — the shape this catalog has already ruled position-less three times on this very series under A7/A2 (ep 103 and ep 133, Chibiusa's and Diana's relocated debuts; ep 113, Hotaru's), each of which carries a rearranged annotation and NO anchor. Under the SLIVER CLAUSE an advanced debut plus a dream-framed preview of Act 19's imagery is a sliver: canon material, but it earns neither a type nor an anchor; the tie is kept as loose_parallel{18-19}.
